departments.name: Cardiology
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of heart and blood vessel conditions, including ECG, echocardiography and stress testing.

departments.name: General Medicine
departments.description: First point of care for fever, infections, diabetes, blood pressure and general adult health concerns.

departments.name: Orthopedics
departments.description: Bone, joint, spine and sports-injury care, including fracture management and joint replacement consultation.

departments.name: Pediatrics
departments.description: Healthcare for infants, children and adolescents, including immunisation and growth monitoring.

departments.name: Gynecology
departments.description: Women's health, pregnancy care, antenatal check-ups and gynaecological consultation.

departments.name: Dermatology
departments.description: Skin, hair and nail conditions, including allergy patch testing and cosmetic dermatology consultation.

departments.name: Neurology
departments.description: Disorders of the brain, spine and nervous system, including headache, epilepsy and stroke follow-up care.

departments.name: ENT
departments.description: Ear, nose and throat care, including hearing assessment, sinus treatment and tonsil surgery consultation.

departments.name: Emergency
departments.description: 24/7 emergency and trauma care. Walk-in only — no appointment is required or taken for emergency care.

departments.name: Radiology
departments.description: Diagnostic imaging services including X-Ray, ultrasound and CT scan, with same-day reporting for most studies.

departments.name: Pathology
departments.description: Laboratory testing including blood, urine and tissue analysis, with home sample collection on request.
